falsification: A calibration-free EB shape analysis over l = 300-3000 at SO-LAT-like or better sensitivity finds beta_eff(l) consistent with flat where the stored curves predict rejection of a flat rotation at > 3 sigma for every admissible phase (CMB-S4-like: min 8.8 sigma): STUR-M3a excluded
The measured beta_eff(l) is inconsistent at > 3 sigma with the stored curve of every admissible phase: STUR-M3a excluded
A flat rotation is rejected and the decline matches a stored curve: consistent with STUR-M3a (not proof; l-dependent instrumental EB and lensing remapping must be excluded first)

known_limitation.issue: registered calibration weights l = 50-1500 with LiteBIRD noise, but beta_now comes from ACT DR6 + Planck (l up to ~3000); M3a's beta_eff declines at high l, so the angle such an analysis would report differs

not_modelled: lensing remapping of the EB pattern
pipeline: GENESIS v10 Stage 10c2 (STUR-M3a high-l addendum, CAMB 2.0.5)
rules: A0(delta) by the registered Stage 10c rule; no re-solving, nothing fitted

shape_test.method: Delta chi^2 of best-fit flat rotation (free angle) against M3a EB; sigma = sqrt(Delta chi^2)
